name: pf-salary-cst-reference
description: French Polynesia salary contribution de solidarité territoriale reference for reviewers checking CST-S and monthly multiple-income CST components. Covers the captured gross-income scope, progressive bands, strict non-collection threshold, evidenced withholding deductions, deferred-income attribution, monthly and quarterly returns, named-person annexes and the July 2026 repeal of the annual annex exception. Includes fictional raw arithmetic and source conflicts. Trigger on Polynesian salary CST, CST-S, CST-M, forms 4010, 4010-A or 4020. This source-cited draft does not establish complete current law, CPS social insurance, net payroll, final assessments or filing readiness.
